emma_csm: FYI we got BlueHarbor.ai's vendor risk form back. There are a few ambiguous answers that could impact their onboarding and upcoming renewal. Renewal health check is scheduled next month.

ryan_sec: thx emma. can you post the link and a quick list of the ambiguities?

emma_csm: Link (internal): https://redwood-internal/secure/forms/blueharbor-2026. Highlights: 1) DPA data residency checkbox = 'US' but notes say 'support EU on request' (no SLA). 2) SOC2: provided cert but no control narratives for 'access control' and 'key rotation'. 3) Vendor risk form: third-party subprocessors field marked 'see annex' but annex missing. 4) Encryption-in-transit answer = 'TLS1.2+' (need cipher suites).

priya_legal: we should ask for the annex and clarify residency terms before signing any private deployment addendum. If they want EU-only, legal needs explicit clause.

ryan_sec: I'll take the SOC2/control narratives and the TLS cipher question. Priya, can you advise on redline language for DPA EU-only clause?

priya_legal: yes, I'll draft a short amendment template: EU-only storage option + KMS key residency + penalties for noncompliance. ETA EOD.

ai-ops-bot: Action created: "Request missing annex + SOC2 control narratives" assigned to emma_csm (due 1742589600).

tom_onboard: putting a hold on their Dedicated onboarding tasks until we confirm subprocessors and residency. I'll note impact in onboarding tracker.

emma_csm: customer feedback note: they mentioned latency in eu-west as their main blocker for going 100% live. Might be okay if we confirm EU-region isolation. Also asked if Redwood supports customer-managed keys for private deployment.

ryan_sec: customer-managed keys = supported on Private with HSM/KMS integrations. We need to confirm which KMS providers they use. I'll include that in the ask.

priya_legal: next steps summary: 1) Emma - request missing annex + ask for explicit EU-only option and KMS provider list (today). 2) Ryan - request SOC2 control narratives for access control & key rotation, and cipher suite details (today). 3) Tom - pause dedicated onboarding tasks and update risk flag (done). 4) Priya - prepare DPA amendment template (EOD).

emma_csm: drafting outbound email now, will CC priya_legal and ryan_sec. I'll update the thread when I get a response. :pray:
